title: complaint is understood and the identity policy is applied before anything else
customerSaid: I cancelled my subscription 9 days ago but I was charged again 3 days ago.
agentReply: A charge posted after a valid cancellation request is eligible for a billing review. You can ask for any charge posted in the last 60 days to be reviewed by the billing team. Opening a review does not automatically refund, reverse, or credit anything, and support staff never promise a refund during an investigation. Billing reviews are normally decided within 5 business days, and if approved, refund processing happens in the billing system and may take additional days to appear with your bank.
